transcript.content: I'm so frustrated, I've been working overtime all day and still can't fix this bug

That sounds rough! Debugging can be really draining, especially after a long day of overtime. You've been working hard — take a deep breath and relax for a bit 😊

Here's a joke to lighten the mood:

A product manager walks into a bar and says to the bartender: "Give me a beer."
Bartender: "Large or small?"
Product manager: "Ship the first version — we'll iterate later."

😄 Hope that helped! The bug can wait until tomorrow — take care of yourself first, keep going 💪
